info.title: cscom
info.description: Generates COM interop assemblies and projects from type libraries using source-generated COM interop, so that they can be used with Native AOT.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generates COM interop code from type libraries and interop assemblies using source-generated COM interop.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: The verbosity of the output. [default: Normal]

commands.name: project
commands.description: Creates or updates an interop project.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Generates a new C# project with the interop types of type libraries or interop assemblies.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory.

options.name: --name
options.description: The project and assembly name. Interop.<Library> by default with a single source; required with several sources.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace of a library, e.g. Excel=Office.Excel, whether it is a source or is used by them; can be repeated. A namespace without a library name is the namespace of a single source. Interop.<Library> by default.

options.name: --framework
options.description: The target framework; can be specified multiple times. net10.0-windows by default.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: The target runtime identifier; can be specified multiple times. AnyCPU by default.

options.name: --csharp-version
options.description: The C# version of the generated code. C# 14 for .NET 10 and C# 15 for .NET 11 by default.

options.name: --single-file
options.description: Generates all types into a single C# file instead of a file per type. [default: False]

options.name: --support-code
options.description: Where the support code (IDispatch, activation, late binding) comes from: the CsCom.Runtime package, or public or internal types emitted into the project. [default: Package]

options.name: --date-marshalling
options.description: How DATE parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (DateTime), none (double) or wrapper (ComDate). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are double. [default: Bcl]

options.name: --currency-marshalling
options.description: How CURRENCY parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (decimal), none (long) or wrapper (ComCurrency). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are long. [default: Bcl]

options.name: --bool-marshalling
options.description: How VARIANT_BOOL parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (bool), none (short) or wrapper (ComBool). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are short. [default: Bcl]

options.name: --bstr-marshalling
options.description: How BSTR parameters and return values are represented: string (string), wrapper (ComBstr, which wraps the native string without copying it) or none (the BSTR pointer). [default: String]

options.name: --safearray-marshalling
options.description: How typed SAFEARRAY(T) parameters and return values are represented: array (one-dimensional T[]), sysarray (System.Array of up to three dimensions), wrapper (ComSafeArray<T>) or none (the SAFEARRAY pointer). [default: Array]

options.name: --event-style
options.description: The code generated for the events of coclasses: a sink class with .NET events (events) or observables (observable) and a handler interface, only the handler interface (interface), or none. [default: Events]

options.name: --struct-properties
options.description: Whether structure members converted to .NET types are generated as properties over private fields of the COM types (auto), or all members are public fields of the COM types (never). [default: Auto]

options.name: --overloads-for-default-values
options.description: Generates overloads for the methods whose optional parameters have default values that C# cannot express (e.g. ComBool.True or a DateTime), so that these parameters can be omitted. [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: An XML file that adds and configures the model and syntax transformers of a library, e.g. Excel=excel.cscom.xml, whether it is a source or is used by them; can be repeated. A file without a library name applies to a single source.

options.name: --reference-path
options.description: For interop assemblies: an assembly that the interop assembly references, or a directory of such assemblies; can be repeated. The directory of the interop assembly and the global assembly cache are searched as well.

options.name: --package-source
options.description: An additional NuGet package source that provides the CsCom.Runtime package.

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: The source of the interop types: a type library (a .tlb file, or a .dll, .ocx or .exe file with an embedded type library), a registered LIBID ({GUID} or {GUID}:major.minor) or ProgID, or a .NET interop assembly, such as a primary interop assembly or the output of TlbImp. Several sources are generated together, each library into its own namespace, and the types that they use from other libraries into the namespaces of these libraries.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Regenerates the C# files of a project created with 'cscom project create'.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace of a library, e.g. Excel=Office.Excel, whether it is a source or is used by them; can be repeated. A namespace without a library name is the namespace of a single source. Interop.<Library> by default. The namespaces recorded in cscom.json by default; LIBRARY= removes the namespace of a library.

options.name: --csharp-version
options.description: The C# version of the generated code. C# 14 for .NET 10 and C# 15 for .NET 11 by default.

options.name: --single-file
options.description: Whether all types are generated into a single C# file; the value recorded in cscom.json by default.

options.name: --date-marshalling
options.description: How DATE parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (DateTime), none (double) or wrapper (ComDate). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are double.

options.name: --currency-marshalling
options.description: How CURRENCY parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (decimal), none (long) or wrapper (ComCurrency). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are long.

options.name: --bool-marshalling
options.description: How VARIANT_BOOL parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (bool), none (short) or wrapper (ComBool). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are short.

options.name: --bstr-marshalling
options.description: How BSTR parameters and return values are represented: string (string), wrapper (ComBstr, which wraps the native string without copying it) or none (the BSTR pointer).

options.name: --safearray-marshalling
options.description: How typed SAFEARRAY(T) parameters and return values are represented: array (one-dimensional T[]), sysarray (System.Array of up to three dimensions), wrapper (ComSafeArray<T>) or none (the SAFEARRAY pointer).

options.name: --event-style
options.description: The code generated for the events of coclasses: a sink class with .NET events (events) or observables (observable) and a handler interface, only the handler interface (interface), or none. The value recorded in cscom.json by default.

options.name: --struct-properties
options.description: Whether structure members converted to .NET types are generated as properties over private fields of the COM types (auto), or all members are public fields of the COM types (never). The value recorded in cscom.json by default.

options.name: --overloads-for-default-values
options.description: Generates overloads for the methods whose optional parameters have default values that C# cannot express (e.g. ComBool.True or a DateTime), so that these parameters can be omitted. The value recorded in cscom.json by default.

options.name: --config
options.description: An XML file that adds and configures the model and syntax transformers of a library, e.g. Excel=excel.cscom.xml, whether it is a source or is used by them; can be repeated. A file without a library name applies to a single source. The files recorded in cscom.json by default; LIBRARY= removes the file of a library, and an empty value removes all of them.

options.name: --reference-path
options.description: For interop assemblies: an assembly that the interop assembly references, or a directory of such assemblies; can be repeated. The directory of the interop assembly and the global assembly cache are searched as well. The paths recorded in cscom.json by default; an empty value removes them.

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: The source of the interop types: a type library (a .tlb file, or a .dll, .ocx or .exe file with an embedded type library), a registered LIBID ({GUID} or {GUID}:major.minor) or ProgID, or a .NET interop assembly, such as a primary interop assembly or the output of TlbImp. Several sources are generated together, each library into its own namespace, and the types that they use from other libraries into the namespaces of these libraries. The sources recorded in cscom.json by default.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Writes a starter cscom.xml configuration file, unless it exists, and the cscom.xsd schema that gives IntelliSense in XML editors.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory.

commands.name: reference
commands.description: Manages the CsComReference items of a project, whose interop code the CsCom.Build package generates during the build.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Adds CsComReference items for type libraries or interop assemblies to a project, whose interop code the CsCom.Build package generates during the build, and a reference to CsCom.Build if the project has none. The items of sources that the project has are updated. Only the specified options are written as metadata of the items, so that the CsCom* properties of the project apply to the others.

options.name: --project
options.description: The project file, or a directory that contains a single project file; the current directory by default.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace of a single source. Interop.<Library> by default.

options.name: --date-marshalling
options.description: How DATE parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (DateTime), none (double) or wrapper (ComDate). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are double.

options.name: --currency-marshalling
options.description: How CURRENCY parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (decimal), none (long) or wrapper (ComCurrency). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are long.

options.name: --bool-marshalling
options.description: How VARIANT_BOOL parameters, return values and structure members are represented: bcl (bool), none (short) or wrapper (ComBool). With '--struct-properties never', bcl structure members are short.

options.name: --bstr-marshalling
options.description: How BSTR parameters and return values are represented: string (string), wrapper (ComBstr, which wraps the native string without copying it) or none (the BSTR pointer).

options.name: --safearray-marshalling
options.description: How typed SAFEARRAY(T) parameters and return values are represented: array (one-dimensional T[]), sysarray (System.Array of up to three dimensions), wrapper (ComSafeArray<T>) or none (the SAFEARRAY pointer).

options.name: --event-style
options.description: The code generated for the events of coclasses: a sink class with .NET events (events) or observables (observable) and a handler interface, only the handler interface (interface), or none.

options.name: --struct-properties
options.description: Whether structure members converted to .NET types are generated as properties over private fields of the COM types (auto), or all members are public fields of the COM types (never).

options.name: --overloads-for-default-values
options.description: Generates overloads for the methods whose optional parameters have default values that C# cannot express (e.g. ComBool.True or a DateTime), so that these parameters can be omitted.

options.name: --config
options.description: An XML file that adds and configures the model and syntax transformers of the sources, written relative to the project.

options.name: --reference-path
options.description: For interop assemblies: an assembly that the interop assembly references, or a directory of such assemblies; can be repeated. The directory of the interop assembly and the global assembly cache are searched as well.

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: The source of the interop types: a type library (a .tlb file, or a .dll, .ocx or .exe file with an embedded type library), a registered LIBID ({GUID} or {GUID}:major.minor) or ProgID, or a .NET interop assembly, such as a primary interop assembly or the output of TlbImp. A file is written relative to the project, unless it only shares the drive with it, e.g. a system file.

commands.description: Lists the CsComReference items written in a project file with their metadata.

options.description: The project file, or a directory that contains a single project file; the current directory by default.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Removes CsComReference items from a project. The reference to the CsCom.Build package is kept.

options.name: --project

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: The source of an item to remove, as the project file or 'cscom reference list' shows it; a file can also be relative to the current directory.

commands.description: Generates the code of the CsComReference items of a project for the MSBuild task of CsCom.Build.
